Class InstrumentLogoService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.InstrumentLogoService
@Service public class InstrumentLogoService extends Object
Resolves company and issuer logos for securities and serves catalog searches for the logo selection dialog.

Resolution follows four strictly disjoint stages (first match wins):

  1. Explicit assignment via security.id_instrument_logo (either deployed or DB-stored SVG).
  2. Exact ISIN match against deployed catalog entries (asset_path IS NOT NULL).
  3. Automatic issuer matching for ETF, MUTUAL_FUND and ISSUER_RISK_PRODUCT against deployed LogoScope.ISSUER entries: longest whole-token name_patterns match first, then product-link hosts / host_suffixes in stored catalog order.
  4. null when none of the above matches.

User-uploaded DB SVGs (asset_path IS NULL) never trigger automatic stages 2 or 3; they take effect only when explicitly assigned to a security.

    • search

      public List<InstrumentLogoRefDto> search(String name, String isin, LogoScope scope, Integer idInstrumentLogo, String productLink, SpecialInvestmentInstruments instrument)
      Searches the shared logo catalog for Dialog (D).

      isin matches exact ISINs only; name matches substring hits on instrument_logo.name, the catalog name appearing as whole words inside the entered search text, and whole-token name_patterns appearing inside the entered search text. The second rule lets the name of a derived instrument such as "Pfizer Inc. CFD" find the company logo "PFIZER". When initial security context (idInstrumentLogo, productLink or instrument) is supplied, the security's currently resolved logo is guaranteed to appear first in the result list.
